meanings.definition_en: to make it easier for someone to do something
meanings.example_en: Can you help me move this table?
meanings.example_es: ¿Me puedes ayudar a mover esta mesa?

meanings.definition_en: to avoid or prevent (used with can't/couldn't)
meanings.example_en: I couldn't help laughing.
meanings.example_es: No pude evitar reírme.

meanings.definition_en: assistance; the act of helping
meanings.example_en: Thanks for your help with the report.
meanings.example_es: Gracias por tu ayuda con el reporte.

meanings.definition_en: a person who helps someone
meanings.example_en: We hired a helper for the workshop.
meanings.example_es: Contratamos un ayudante para el taller.

meanings.definition_en: giving useful assistance
meanings.example_en: Your feedback was really helpful.
meanings.example_es: Tu retroalimentación fue muy útil.

meanings.definition_en: helpless: unable to help oneself or act
meanings.example_en: I felt helpless watching the machine fail.
meanings.example_es: Me sentí indefenso viendo fallar la máquina.

meanings.definition_en: in a way that gives useful assistance
meanings.example_en: She helpfully pointed out the error.
meanings.example_es: Ella, servicial, señaló el error.

phrasals.example_en: He helped out with the setup.
phrasals.example_es: Echó una mano con la instalación.

notes_es: Ojo con el par helpful / helpless: mismo sustantivo, sufijos opuestos (-ful = con, -less = sin).

meanings.definition_en: to remain in a place
meanings.example_en: I stayed home all weekend.
meanings.example_es: Me quedé en casa todo el fin de semana.

meanings.definition_en: to live somewhere temporarily
meanings.example_en: We stayed at a small hotel downtown.
meanings.example_es: Nos alojamos en un hotel pequeño del centro.

meanings.definition_en: to remain in a particular state
meanings.example_en: Stay calm and check the pressure first.
meanings.example_es: Mantén la calma y revisa la presión primero.

meanings.definition_en: to postpone or halt a legal action
meanings.example_en: The court stayed the execution of the order.
meanings.example_es: El tribunal suspendió la ejecución de la orden.

meanings.definition_en: a period of time spent somewhere
meanings.example_en: It was a two-night stay.
meanings.example_es: Fue una estancia de dos noches.

meanings.definition_en: a legal order stopping a process
meanings.example_en: They were granted a stay of execution.
meanings.example_es: Les concedieron una suspensión de la ejecución.

meanings.definition_en: gerund: the act of staying, used as a noun
meanings.example_en: Staying home is cheaper than traveling.
meanings.example_es: Quedarse en casa es más barato que viajar.

meanings.definition_en: attributive use: staying power = endurance
meanings.example_en: That design has real staying power.
meanings.example_es: Ese diseño tiene verdadero aguante.

phrasals.example_en: I stayed up until 2 a.m. finishing the drawing.
phrasals.example_es: Me quedé despierto hasta las 2 terminando el plano.
No te quedes fuera hasta muy tarde.

phrasals.example_en: You can stay over if it gets late.
phrasals.example_es: Puedes quedarte a dormir si se hace tarde.

phrasals.example_en: She stayed on as a consultant.

notes_es: No tiene adjetivo ni adverbio propios. 'stay at' NO es adjetivo: es el verbo + preposición. El compuesto stay-at-home sí funciona como adjetivo (a stay-at-home parent).

meanings.definition_en: to have information in your mind
meanings.example_en: I know how the valve works.
meanings.example_es: Sé cómo funciona la válvula.

meanings.definition_en: to be familiar with a person or place
meanings.example_en: I've known him since college.
meanings.example_es: Lo conozco desde la universidad.

meanings.definition_en: information and understanding you have
meanings.example_en: He has deep knowledge of thermodynamics.
meanings.example_es: Tiene un conocimiento profundo de termodinámica.

meanings.definition_en: recognized or established
meanings.example_en: That's a known issue in this model.
meanings.example_es: Ese es un problema conocido en este modelo.

meanings.definition_en: unknown: not known
meanings.example_en: The cause is still unknown.
meanings.example_es: La causa sigue siendo desconocida.

meanings.definition_en: deliberately, being aware of what you do
meanings.example_en: He knowingly signed a false report.
meanings.example_es: Firmó a sabiendas un informe falso.

phrasals.example_en: Did you know about the delay?
It's a well-known standard in the industry.
phrasals.example_es: Es un estándar muy conocido en la industria.

notes_es: know es irregular: know → knew → known. El participio 'known' hace de adjetivo (a known issue), que es distinto del sustantivo 'knowledge'.

meanings.definition_en: to make someone want to pay attention
meanings.example_en: The proposal interested the whole team.
meanings.example_es: La propuesta interesó a todo el equipo.

meanings.definition_en: the feeling of wanting to know about something
meanings.example_en: She has a real interest in robotics.
meanings.example_es: Tiene un interés real en la robótica.

meanings.definition_en: money paid for the use of money
meanings.example_en: The loan has a 6% interest rate.
meanings.example_es: El préstamo tiene una tasa de interés del 6%.

meanings.definition_en: -ing form: describes the thing that causes the feeling
meanings.example_en: The lecture was interesting.
meanings.example_es: La conferencia fue interesante.

meanings.definition_en: -ed form (interested): describes the person who feels it
meanings.example_en: I'm interested in the lecture.
meanings.example_es: Estoy interesado en la conferencia.

meanings.definition_en: used to introduce a surprising fact
meanings.example_en: Interestingly, the cheaper part lasted longer.
meanings.example_es: Curiosamente, la pieza más barata duró más.

contrast_es: interesting = lo que causa la sensación (la clase es interesante). interested = quien la siente (yo estoy interesado). Decir 'I am interesting' significa que TÚ resultas interesante para los demás, no que algo te interesa.

meanings.definition_en: to make someone feel tired and uninterested
meanings.example_en: Long meetings bore me.
meanings.example_es: Las reuniones largas me aburren.

meanings.definition_en: the state of being bored
meanings.example_en: He quit out of sheer boredom.
meanings.example_es: Renunció de puro aburrimiento.

meanings.definition_en: -ing form: the thing that causes the feeling
meanings.example_en: The training video was boring.
meanings.example_es: El video de capacitación era aburrido.

meanings.definition_en: -ed form (bored): the person who feels it
meanings.example_en: I was bored during the video.
meanings.example_es: Yo estaba aburrido durante el video.

contrast_es: El español usa 'aburrido' para las dos cosas; el inglés no. boring = la cosa que aburre. bored = la persona aburrida. 'I am boring' = yo soy la persona aburridora. Misma regla que interesting/interested, tiring/tired, confusing/confused.

meanings.definition_en: to succeed in doing or getting something
meanings.example_en: We achieved the target ahead of schedule.
meanings.example_es: Logramos la meta antes de lo previsto.

meanings.definition_en: something done successfully
meanings.example_en: Finishing the thesis was a real achievement.
meanings.example_es: Terminar la tesis fue un verdadero logro.

meanings.definition_en: someone who achieves a lot
meanings.example_en: She's a high achiever.
meanings.example_es: Ella es una persona de altos logros.

meanings.definition_en: possible to achieve
meanings.example_en: Set achievable deadlines.
meanings.example_es: Pon plazos alcanzables.

notes_es: No tiene adverbio de uso normal. El sufijo -able convierte el verbo en 'que se puede hacer' (achieve → achievable), igual que en manage → manageable.

meanings.definition_en: to achieve what you wanted
meanings.example_en: They succeeded in reducing the vibration.
meanings.example_es: Lograron reducir la vibración.

meanings.definition_en: to take someone's position after them
meanings.example_en: He succeeded her as head of design.
meanings.example_es: La sucedió como jefe de diseño.

meanings.definition_en: the achievement of a goal
meanings.example_en: The launch was a success.
meanings.example_es: El lanzamiento fue un éxito.

meanings.definition_en: having achieved the intended result
meanings.example_en: It was a successful test run.
meanings.example_es: Fue una prueba exitosa.

meanings.definition_en: unsuccessful: not achieving the result
meanings.example_en: The first attempt was unsuccessful.
meanings.example_es: El primer intento fue fallido.

meanings.definition_en: in a way that achieves the goal
meanings.example_en: The model ran successfully overnight.
meanings.example_es: El modelo corrió con éxito toda la noche.

notes_es: Familia irregular en la derivación: succeed → success (no 'succeedment'). Es justo por esto que las familias no se pueden calcular con reglas.

meanings.definition_en: to choose after thinking
meanings.example_en: We decided to postpone the test.
meanings.example_es: Decidimos posponer la prueba.

meanings.definition_en: a choice that you make
meanings.example_en: That was a tough decision.
meanings.example_es: Esa fue una decisión difícil.

meanings.definition_en: a person with authority to decide
meanings.example_en: Talk to the decision-maker, not the assistant.
meanings.example_es: Habla con quien toma las decisiones, no con el asistente.

meanings.definition_en: able to make decisions quickly
meanings.example_en: A good lead has to be decisive.
meanings.example_es: Un buen líder tiene que ser decidido.

meanings.definition_en: settling an issue; conclusive
meanings.example_en: That test was decisive.
meanings.example_es: Esa prueba fue decisiva.

meanings.definition_en: in a firm, quick way
meanings.example_en: He acted decisively.
meanings.example_es: Actuó de forma decidida.

notes_es: decide → decision (la 'd' se vuelve 's'). Mismo patrón en conclude → conclusion, provide → provision.

meanings.definition_en: the state of being happy
meanings.example_en: Money doesn't guarantee happiness.
meanings.example_es: El dinero no garantiza la felicidad.

meanings.definition_en: feeling pleasure or satisfaction
meanings.example_en: I'm happy with the result.
meanings.example_es: Estoy contento con el resultado.

meanings.definition_en: unhappy: not happy
meanings.example_en: The client was unhappy with the delay.
meanings.example_es: El cliente estaba descontento con el retraso.

meanings.definition_en: in a happy way; willingly
meanings.example_en: I'd happily review the draft.
meanings.example_es: Con gusto reviso el borrador.

notes_es: Familia SIN verbo: 'to happy' no existe. Otro caso donde la matriz tiene huecos legítimos. Ojo con la ortografía: happy → happily (la y pasa a i).

meanings.definition_en: the ability to recover quickly from difficulty
meanings.example_en: The team showed real resilience after the failure.
meanings.example_es: El equipo mostró verdadera resiliencia tras la falla.

meanings.definition_en: the ability of a material to return to its shape
meanings.example_en: Rubber has high resilience.
meanings.example_es: El caucho tiene alta elasticidad.

meanings.definition_en: able to recover quickly
meanings.example_en: A resilient design tolerates bad input.
meanings.example_es: Un diseño resistente tolera entradas malas.

meanings.definition_en: in a resilient way
meanings.example_en: The structure responded resiliently to the load.
meanings.example_es: La estructura respondió de forma resiliente a la carga.

notes_es: Sin verbo. En ingeniería, resilience es además una propiedad del material (energía que absorbe y devuelve).

meanings.definition_en: to start something that will last
meanings.example_en: They established the lab in 1998.
meanings.example_es: Fundaron el laboratorio en 1998.

meanings.definition_en: to find out a fact with certainty
meanings.example_en: We need to establish the root cause.
meanings.example_es: Necesitamos determinar la causa raíz.

meanings.definition_en: the act of establishing, or the place itself
meanings.example_en: The establishment of the standard took years.
meanings.example_es: El establecimiento de la norma tomó años.

meanings.definition_en: -ed form used as adjective: accepted, long-existing
meanings.example_en: That's an established procedure.
meanings.example_es: Ese es un procedimiento establecido.

notes_es: Aquí el participio 'established' funciona como adjetivo pleno (an established procedure), sin ser el par -ing/-ed de emoción.

meanings.definition_en: to start and take responsibility for a task
meanings.example_en: They undertook a full redesign.
meanings.example_es: Emprendieron un rediseño completo.

meanings.definition_en: to promise formally to do something
meanings.example_en: The supplier undertook to deliver by March.
meanings.example_es: El proveedor se comprometió a entregar en marzo.

meanings.definition_en: a large or difficult task that has been started
meanings.example_en: Migrating the whole system is a huge undertaking.
meanings.example_es: Migrar todo el sistema es una tarea enorme.

meanings.definition_en: a formal promise
meanings.example_en: They gave a written undertaking.
meanings.example_es: Dieron un compromiso por escrito.

notes_es: Verbo irregular (undertake → undertook → undertaken). El -ing aquí es un SUSTANTIVO pleno (an undertaking = una empresa/tarea), no un adjetivo ni un tiempo continuo.

meanings.definition_en: to support a weight or load
meanings.example_en: This column bears most of the load.
meanings.example_es: Esta columna soporta la mayor parte de la carga.

meanings.definition_en: to endure something unpleasant
meanings.example_en: I can't bear that noise.
meanings.example_es: No soporto ese ruido.

meanings.definition_en: a machine part that supports a rotating shaft
meanings.example_en: A ball bearing reduces friction.
meanings.example_es: Un rodamiento de bolas reduce la fricción.

meanings.definition_en: relevance to something (to have bearing on)
meanings.example_en: That has no bearing on the result.
meanings.example_es: Eso no tiene relación con el resultado.

meanings.definition_en: possible to tolerate
meanings.example_en: The heat was barely bearable.
meanings.example_es: El calor era apenas soportable.

meanings.definition_en: unbearable: impossible to tolerate
meanings.example_en: The vibration was unbearable.
meanings.example_es: La vibración era insoportable.

notes_es: Buen ejemplo de -ing convertido en sustantivo TÉCNICO: bearing = rodamiento, ya no es 'soportando'. El sustantivo se independizó del verbo.

meanings.definition_en: to use something to maximum advantage
meanings.example_en: We leveraged the existing test rig.
meanings.example_es: Aprovechamos el banco de pruebas existente.

meanings.definition_en: the mechanical advantage from using a lever
meanings.example_en: A longer wrench gives you more leverage.
meanings.example_es: Una llave más larga te da más apalancamiento.

meanings.definition_en: power to influence a situation
meanings.example_en: We have no leverage in this negotiation.
meanings.example_es: No tenemos poder de negociación aquí.

notes_es: Caso de CONVERSIÓN: la misma forma sirve de verbo y de sustantivo sin cambiar nada. Igual que water, email, run.
